summary: Apply collection field patches only to rows held before the changes frame.

schema.detail: No JSON or database schema changes.

rules.detail: No fleet or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The TypeScript fold matches the Rust fold: a patch cannot borrow its base from a new upsert in the same frame. Missing patch bases request a fresh snapshot without partially changing the held window; a full replacement remains authoritative. Valid server frames and ordinary subscriptions keep their existing behavior.

manual.detail: No new option beyond the existing field_deltas opt-in.

recovery.detail: Reconnect or refetch returns complete rows.
